scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently "npm run dev:mock -w backend" "npm run dev:mock -w frontend"
scripts.dev:local: concurrently "npm run emulators:start" "npm run dev:local -w backend" "npm run dev:local -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test:typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck:test -w frontend
